title: National Biodiversity Authority (NBA) Access and Benefit Sharing (ABS) Operational & Legal Knowledge Base
statutory_act: Biological Diversity Act, 2002 (as amended by Biological Diversity (Amendment) Act, 2023)

legal_rules.rule_name: Prior NBA Approval for Foreign Entity Access
legal_rules.section_or_rule: Section 3 & Section 3A, Biological Diversity Act, 2002 (as amended 2023)
legal_rules.description: Any person who is not a citizen of India, or an entity incorporated outside India, or an Indian company having foreign participation or control, must obtain prior approval of the National Biodiversity Authority (NBA) before obtaining any biological resource occurring in India or associated traditional knowledge.

legal_rules.rule_name: Prior Intimation to State Biodiversity Board for Indian Entities
legal_rules.description: Indian citizens and Indian entities without foreign shareholding/control obtaining Indian biological resources for commercial utilisation must give prior intimation to the concerned State Biodiversity Board (SBB).

legal_rules.rule_name: Prior NBA Approval for IPR Applications Based on Indian Biological Resources
legal_rules.description: No person shall apply for any intellectual property right, in India or outside India, for any invention based on any research or information on a biological resource obtained from India, without obtaining prior approval of the NBA.

legal_rules.rule_name: Transfer of Research Results to Foreign Entities
legal_rules.description: No person shall transfer the results of any research relating to any biological resource occurring in or obtained from India to any foreign entity/individual without prior approval of NBA.

legal_rules.rule_name: Third Party Transfer of Biological Resource or Knowledge
legal_rules.description: No person who has been granted approval under Section 3 shall transfer any biological resource or knowledge to a third party without prior approval of the NBA.

special_cases_and_exemptions.name: Cultivated Medicinal Plants Exemption
special_cases_and_exemptions.consequence: Exempt from routine NBA benefit sharing requirements for access, provided a valid Certificate of Origin issued by competent State Agriculture/Forest/AYUSH authority is maintained.

special_cases_and_exemptions.name: Codified Traditional Knowledge & Registered AYUSH Practitioner Exemption
special_cases_and_exemptions.consequence: Registered AYUSH practitioners and domestic manufacturers practicing codified traditional knowledge in Indian systems of medicine are exempted from prior SBB intimation/NBA access approval fees for traditional formulations.

special_cases_and_exemptions.name: Normally Traded Commodities (NTC) Exemption
special_cases_and_exemptions.consequence: Biological resources notified as Normally Traded Commodities purchased from open market strictly for trade or direct consumption are exempt from ABS access requirements. Exemption DOES NOT apply if used for research, IP filing, or commercial product extraction.

special_cases_and_exemptions.name: Foreign Biological Resources Exemption
special_cases_and_exemptions.consequence: Indian domestic BDA access requirements do not apply to biological resources obtained outside India. Compliance with Nagoya Protocol / Provider Country ABS laws is required.

special_cases_and_exemptions.name: Collaborative Government Research Exemption
special_cases_and_exemptions.consequence: Exempt from Sections 3 and 4 approvals if research project conforms to Central Government guidelines and is approved by Central Government.

special_cases_and_exemptions.name: ITPGRFA Multilateral System Exemption
special_cases_and_exemptions.source_provision: International Treaty on Plant Genetic Resources for Food and Agriculture (ITPGRFA)
special_cases_and_exemptions.consequence: Plant genetic resources for food and agriculture covered under the ITPGRFA Multilateral System (MLS) accessed under a Standard Material Transfer Agreement (SMTA) are exempt from domestic BDA prior approval.

special_cases_and_exemptions.name: Foreign Repository Microorganism Exemption
special_cases_and_exemptions.consequence: Microorganisms sourced directly from authorized international depositories outside India without Indian field collection fall outside domestic BDA access jurisdiction.

special_cases_and_exemptions.name: Community Traditional Knowledge Protection
special_cases_and_exemptions.consequence: Community-held uncodified traditional knowledge requires explicit Prior Informed Consent (PIC) and Mutually Agreed Terms (MAT) with local indigenous communities / benefit claimers.

forms.form_name: Form I - Application for Access to Biological Resources and Associated Traditional Knowledge
forms.purpose: Prior approval for foreign entities/individuals to access Indian biological resources or TK for research or commercial utilization.
required_documents: Details of biological resource and scientific name
MOU / Agreement with local supplier or community

forms.form_name: Form II - Application for Transfer of Results of Research
forms.purpose: Prior approval to transfer research results on Indian biological resources to foreign individuals or entities.
required_documents: Copy of draft agreement or transfer terms

forms.form_name: Form III - Application for Seeking Approval for Applying for Intellectual Property Rights
forms.purpose: Prior approval before applying for IP rights (patent or otherwise) in India or abroad based on Indian biological resources.
required_documents: Source and geographical origin declaration of biological resource
Details of associated Traditional Knowledge used

forms.form_name: Form IV - Application for Seeking Approval for Third Party Transfer
forms.purpose: Prior approval for transferring accessed biological resource or knowledge to a third party.
Prior intimation by Indian citizens/companies to State Biodiversity Board before commercial utilization of biological resources.
forms.fee: Nominal State Intimation Fee (as specified by relevant SBB)
required_documents: List of biological ingredients and source traders/cultivators

forms.form_name: Certificate of Origin for Cultivated Medicinal Plants
forms.purpose: Official certification establishing that medicinal plant material was sourced from registered cultivated farmland/nursery.
forms.authority: State Agriculture Department / Forest Department / AYUSH Officer
required_documents: Trader / Purchase Invoice from registered farmer

commercial_utilisation.description: 0.1% of annual gross ex-factory sales / turnover

0.5% of annual gross ex-factory sales / turnover

ipr_commercialisation.description: 1.0% to 3.0% of gross royalty / fee received from licensing or commercialisation of IPR
